# Language-model fine-tuning notebook — fleet-sweep fixes

**Source:** the 2026-10-05 static fleet sweep of `main` flagged this notebook for the old restart guard (in-kernel
`pip install`, then "Restart the runtime" on stale modules) and a missing guided layer (2 of 9 guided markers in a
notebook that declares `GUIDED`). This is a targeted fix; **no full Notebook Review Framework v1 review has been done**.
**Base:** `main` at `311b3c0`.
**Notebook:** `tutorials/language_model_finetuning_colab.ipynb`, regenerated by `tools/build_notebook.py` (`build_notebook.py/2.2`).
**Readiness:** **Verification pending** (offline verification only; a hosted one-pass Run all is required).
**Status labels:** unchanged.

All changes are in the generator, the templates, the validators and a new lock; both notebooks are regenerated and
`--check` is clean for both templates. The default path computes the same thing as before (same data, splits,
baseline, training loop, report and exports); what changed is how the runtime is installed, the guided layer, the
frozen-base guard on re-runs, BYOD, and a guarded download.

## User-visible changes

- Section 1 builds or reuses `dimer_isolated_env_<lock digest>/` and routes later cells there; nothing is installed into
  the kernel, no restart. Linux x86_64 only. New file `tutorials/requirements-isolated.lock.txt`.
- Section 4 gains `BYOD_PATH`; BYOD errors name the file and line.
- Re-running Section 6 or 7 reloads the frozen base first (printed), instead of reusing an adapted model.
- On Colab the bundle ZIP is no longer pushed as a browser download from the isolated worker; the cell prints its path
  (download it from the file browser).
- Guided-layer markdown throughout; the closing gains Troubleshooting, Change one thing, Glossary and Conclusion.
